# rgmin

> Rust local minimization (L-BFGS, BFGS, nonlinear conjugate gradients, Newton, FIRE) that takes one step per call while the host owns the loop, with a C ABI and Python bindings.

- Documentation: https://omnipotentrpc.github.io/rgmin/
- Repository: https://github.com/OmniPotentRPC/rgmin
